subject: Data Engineering
title: Self-Service Analytics
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Self-Service Analytics.

hook.text: Every data question requires a ticket to the data team. The queue is three weeks long.

buildup.text: Self-service analytics gives business users tools to explore data without engineering help.

discovery.text: Curated datasets, semantic layers, and BI tools let analysts answer their own questions.

twist.text: Self-service without guardrails leads to wrong answers. Users need clean, documented, governed data.

climax.text: The goal is autonomy with trust: users explore freely on data the team has validated.

punchline.text: Empower users. Don't become a bottleneck.

quiz.question: What is required for self-service analytics to be effective?
options: Clean, documented, governed data that users can explore
